title: Ow!
description: A dialogue lesson about reporting what someone says. Andy has slipped and fallen downstairs and hurt his back; Lucy tries to help him stand up, but he can't get up, so Lucy phones Dr. Carter, who says he will come at once. Lucy is sure that Andy needs an X-ray. New vocabulary includes ow, slip, fall, downstairs, hurt, back, stand up, help, at once, sure, and X-ray. Workbook practice covers filling in the missing words of the dialogue and matching words into pairs of opposites. Grammar exercises practise reported speech with 'that' (says/thinks/is sure/is sorry/believes/understands/knows), answering 'What's the matter?' using reported-speech clauses, and making sentences with the reported-speech structure 'verb + that + clause'.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Must Andy go to see the doctor?) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (fill in the missing words of the dialogue) has 14 fill-in slots; all answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 key (img/key-095-100.jpg). Practice B (vocabulary opposites) has 6 matching pairs (printed on the workbook, not editable) and 5 fill-in items; item 1 is a printed example and items 2-5 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 key (img/key-095-100.jpg). Grammar I (make sentences according to the example) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 529-530). Grammar II (answer the questions, using the cues given) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 530). Grammar III (make sentences according to the example) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 530).

characters.andy: A man who has slipped and fallen downstairs and hurt his back.
characters.lucy: A woman who helps Andy and phones Dr. Carter.

lesson-099-scene-01.description: Andy slipping and falling downstairs, Lucy helping him try to stand up, Lucy phoning Dr. Carter, and the doctor coming to see Andy.
lesson-099-scene-01.reason: Odd lesson: text first; illustration deferred.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Must Andy go to see the doctor?
听录音，然后回答问题。安迪需要去看医生吗？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the question: Must Andy go to see the doctor?

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.translation: 安迪：我滑了一跤，从楼梯上摔下来了。

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.text:
Yes, I have.
I think that I've hurt my back.
lines.translation: 安迪：是啊，摔伤了。我想我把背摔坏了。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text:
Try and stand up.
Can you stand up?
Here.
Let me help you.
lines.translation: 露西：试试站起来。你能站起来吗？来，让我帮你。

lines.speaker: ANDY
lines.text:
I'm sorry, Lucy.
I'm afraid that I can't get up.
lines.translation: 安迪：对不起，露西。恐怕我站不起来。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text:
I think that the doctor had better see you.
I'll phone Dr. Carter.
lines.translation: 露西：我想最好请医生来给你看一下。我去给卡特医生打电话。

lines.speaker: LUCY
lines.text:
The doctor says that he will come at once.
I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.
lines.translation: 露西：医生说他马上就来。安迪，我看你需要做一次 X 光透视。

lesson.title: Listen then answer this question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Must Andy go to see the doctor? 听录音，然后回答问题。安迪需要去看医生吗？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer: Must Andy go to see the doctor?

questions.prompt: Must Andy go to see the doctor?
questions.answer: No, he needn't. The doctor comes to him — Lucy phones Dr. Carter, who says he will come at once, and Andy needs an X-ray.

items.title: fell downstairs
items.text: fell downstairs, 从楼梯上摔下来。downstairs 是副词，修饰 fell，作状语。

items.title: Try and stand up.
items.text: Try and stand up. 试着站起来。在英语中，常用 and 把两个动词连接在一起，如第 13 课的 come upstairs and see it。这种句子往往用来鼓励某种动作。

items.title: Here.
items.text: Here 在这里是感叹词，意思是“来”或“喂”，引起别人注意。

items.title: Let me help you.
items.text: Let me help you. 让我来帮你。其中 let 有“允许”的意思。注意在 let 后面要加不带 to 的动词不定式。

items.title: The doctor says that he will come at once.
items.text: 在英文中如果要把某人所说的话告诉另一个人，要用间接引语。间接引语不用引号，往往在引语前加 that 等引导词。

practice.title: A — Dialogue: Fill in the missing words
practice.instruction: Read this dialogue. Fill in the missing words. 读这篇对话。填上缺少的词。
practice.translation: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing words.
practice.context: 14 fill-in slots across the dialogue. All answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

questions.prompt: Lucy: What's the ______, Andy?
questions.answer: matter

questions.prompt: Andy: I ______ and ______ downstairs.
questions.answer: slipped, fell

questions.prompt: Lucy: ______ you ______ yourself?
questions.answer: Have, hurt

questions.prompt: Andy: Yes, I have. I think ______ I've ______ my back.
questions.answer: that, hurt

questions.prompt: Lucy: Try and ______ ______.
questions.answer: stand up

questions.prompt: Lucy: ______ you stand up? Here. ______ me help you.
questions.answer: Can, Let

questions.prompt: Andy: I'm ______, Lucy. I'm ______ that I can't ______.
questions.answer: sorry, afraid, get up

questions.prompt: Lucy: I ______ that the doctor had ______ see you. I'll ______ Dr. Carter.
questions.answer: think, better, phone

questions.prompt: Lucy: The ______ says ______ he will come at ______.
questions.answer: doctor, that, once

questions.prompt: Lucy: I'm ______ ______ you need an ______, Andy.
questions.answer: sure, that, X-ray

questions.prompt: Andy: Ow!
questions.answer: Ow

questions.prompt: Andy: Yes, I have. (response to 'Have you hurt yourself?')
questions.answer: Yes, I have.

questions.prompt: Lucy: Can you stand up? (question after 'Try and stand up.')
questions.answer: Can you stand up?

questions.prompt: Lucy: Here. (exclamation before 'Let me help you.')
questions.answer: Here.

practice.text:
Match these words into pairs of opposites. 选出左框中各个词的反义词。

downstairs – upstairs
stand up – sit down
well – ill
hot – cold
right – wrong
buy – sell
small – large
practice.translation: Match these words into pairs of opposites.

practice.title: B — Vocabulary: Fill in the blanks with opposites
practice.instruction: Now fill in the blanks with opposites. 用反义词填空。
practice.translation: Now fill in the blanks with the opposite of the given word.
practice.context: 5 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-5 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

questions.prompt: She isn't downstairs: she's ______.
questions.answer: upstairs

questions.prompt: The attendant didn't give Mr. Hall the right case: he gave him the ______ case.
questions.answer: wrong

questions.prompt: Why are you sitting down? Please ______.
questions.answer: stand up

questions.prompt: I want to buy a bicycle. Do you want to ______ yours?
questions.answer: sell

questions.prompt: I don't feel very well. In fact I feel ______.
questions.answer: ill

grammar.title: I. Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction:
Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。

Example (item 1a):
he says / he feels sleepy
He says that he feels sleepy.
grammar.translation: Make a sentence from each pair of clauses, following the printed example. Join them with 'that'.

grammar.context: 10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 529-530).

questions.prompt: he says / he feels sleepy
questions.answer: He says that he feels sleepy.

questions.prompt: she says / she feels ill
questions.answer: She says that she feels ill.

questions.prompt: he thinks / he needs a haircut
questions.answer: He thinks that he needs a haircut.

questions.prompt: I'm sure / it's going to snow tomorrow
questions.answer: I'm sure that it's going to snow tomorrow.

questions.prompt: the doctor says / you must stay in bed for three days
questions.answer: The doctor says that you must stay in bed for three days.

questions.prompt: I'm sorry / he's got a bad cold
questions.answer: I'm sorry that he's got a bad cold.

questions.prompt: he believes / he can repair the car
questions.answer: He believes that he can repair the car.

questions.prompt: she understands / I'm very tired and thirsty
questions.answer: She understands that I'm very tired and thirsty.

questions.prompt: he says / he usually gets up at seven
questions.answer: He says that he usually gets up at seven.

questions.prompt: I know / Mr. Smith has just sold his house
questions.answer: I know that Mr. Smith has just sold his house.

grammar.title: II. Answer the questions, using the cues given. 根据所给提示回答问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions, using the cues given. 根据所给提示回答问题。

Example (item 1):
What's the matter with you? (feel cold / be afraid / have got a temperature)
I feel cold. I'm afraid that I've got a temperature.
grammar.translation: Answer each 'What's the matter?' question using the cues in parentheses, joining the second part with 'that'.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 8 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-8 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 530).

questions.prompt: What's the matter with you? (feel cold / be afraid / have got a temperature)
questions.answer: I feel cold. I'm afraid that I've got a temperature.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with him? (fall downstairs / think / have hurt his left leg)
questions.answer: He fell downstairs. He thinks that he's hurt his left leg.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with them? (have got mumps / be afraid / can't go to school next week)
questions.answer: They've got mumps. They're afraid that they can't go to school next week.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with you? (have got a headache / believe / have got flu)
questions.answer: I've got a headache. I believe that I've got flu.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with his car? (he / had a car crash yesterday / know / must take it to a garage)
questions.answer: He had a car crash yesterday. He knows that he must take it to a garage.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with your face? (I / shaved this morning and cut myself / think / must be careful next time)
questions.answer: I shaved this morning and cut myself. I think that I must be careful next time.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with her? (have a toothache / think / must see the dentist)
questions.answer: She has a toothache. She thinks that she must see the dentist.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with you? (fall off my bike and hurt my back / think / need an X-ray)
questions.answer: I fell off my bike and hurt my back. I think that I need an X-ray.

grammar.title: III. Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction:
Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。

Example (item 1):
she / say / she / be very happy
She says that she is very happy.
grammar.translation: Make a sentence from each set of cues, following the printed example. Use the reported-speech structure 'verb + that + clause'.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 99 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 530).

questions.prompt: she / say / she / be very happy
questions.answer: She says that she is very happy.

questions.prompt: the children / say / they / already finish / their homework
questions.answer: The children say that they have already finished their homework.

questions.prompt: he / believe / they / arrive / in an hour's time
questions.answer: He believes that they will arrive in an hour's time.

questions.prompt: I / be afraid / it / rain tomorrow
questions.answer: I am afraid that it will rain tomorrow.

questions.prompt: the doctor / be sure / he / have got measles
questions.answer: The doctor is sure that he has got measles.

questions.prompt: the mother / know / her baby / want / some milk
questions.answer: The mother knows that her baby wants some milk.

questions.prompt: the teacher / think / students / be studying hard
questions.answer: The teacher thinks that the students are studying hard.

questions.prompt: I / be sorry / I / be late today
questions.answer: I am sorry that I am late today.

questions.prompt: we / understand / you / need / plenty of money
questions.answer: We understand that you need plenty of money.

questions.prompt: John / say / he / can drive
questions.answer: John says that he can drive.
